policy: Catalogued availability is not integration. Runtime support is enabled only when a backend is detected, its host/guest requirements are satisfied, and its specific acceptance tests pass. Do not claim guest boot compatibility from a package being installed.

backends.name: QEMU TCG
backends.notes: Primary portable cross-ISA emulation path; TCG is emulation, not hardware virtualization.

backends.name: Linux KVM
backends.notes: Requires Linux, /dev/kvm, CPU virtualization extensions and host permissions.

backends.name: Xen Project
backends.notes: Requires a Xen-enabled host and a tested toolstack integration.

backends.name: bhyve
backends.notes: FreeBSD host only; device models and boot workflow need a backend adapter.

backends.name: VirtualBox base package
backends.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (base package; extension pack has separate terms)
backends.notes: Keep extension-pack functionality out of the open-source capability claim.

backends.name: Firecracker
backends.notes: Linux/KVM host, restricted device model; suited to microVM workflows rather than arbitrary desktop guests.

backends.name: Cloud Hypervisor
backends.notes: Requires Linux/KVM and a supported virtio device configuration.

backends.name: crosvm
backends.notes: Linux/KVM host; sandbox and device backend configuration required.

backends.name: ACRN
backends.notes: Target-specific embedded platform and service-OS requirements.

backends.name: Jailhouse
backends.notes: Static partitioning rather than a general-purpose dynamic VM manager.

backends.name: Bao Hypervisor
backends.notes: Static partitioning; supported board and architecture requirements apply.

backends.name: Hafnium
backends.notes: Arm-focused partition manager; architecture and firmware prerequisites apply.

backends.name: OpenBSD vmm/vmd
backends.notes: OpenBSD host-specific; requires vmd control and guest image integration.

backends.name: NetBSD NVMM
backends.notes: NetBSD host-specific API and userspace integration required.

integration_contract.fallback_policy: Explicitly report TCG/software emulation when hardware acceleration is unavailable; do not label it KVM or native virtualization.
required_tests: BIOS and UEFI boot where supported
integration_contract.release_rule: A backend is production-supported only after a backend-specific acceptance workflow passes on its supported host/guest matrix.
